text:
aria: Heads-up — p95 on /v1/infer for service=chatbot spiked ~3x at 11:12 UTC but when I opened the endpoint breakdown the per-variant p95s look flat. Dashboard shows endpoint-level p50/p95/p99 jump though. Anyone seen this pattern?

sam: I saw something similar earlier today. Could be routing switching a small fraction of traffic to a slow quantized fallback, which inflates the endpoint p95 but barely moves variant-level p95 if variant tags are sampled differently.

mike: Can you paste the query you used for the breakdown? We might be showing unweighted averages across variants instead of route-weighted percentiles.

aria: query I opened from Console -> Endpoint -> Latency tab. No custom filters. Here's the raw telemetry query I ran in the backend console:

```
GET /telemetry/query?metric=latency_ms&group_by=variant&percentiles=50,95,99&start=1768887000&end=1768889200&sample_source=dashboard
```

jen: Ah `sample_source=dashboard` is the culprit maybe — dashboard sampling uses 1% lightweight sampling for per-variant panes to keep UI responsive. Endpoint rollups are computed from the full rollup stream. So p95 from rollup != p95 from sampled variant panes.

sam: Right. Two different data flows: (1) live rollup stream used for endpoint-level percentiles (accurate, weighted) and (2) sampled per-variant query used for fast variant breakdown (biased). We should surface that.

aria: That explains it. The UX is bad because the endpoint chart and the variant panels live in the same view but come from different fidelity pipelines. Users think they're looking at the same signal.

mike: Proposal: add a small badge on variant cards that says "sampled view (1%)" and a toggle to run a heavy accurate query (route-weighted) when you need to. Also consider a tooltip that explains "endpoint percentiles are route-weighted rollups; variant panes may be sampled."

jen: Also we have an internal debate about how to present "route-weighted percentiles" vs "uniform percentiles across variants." Product prefers the simpler "endpoint = what user sees", but infra wants to be explicit about sampling differences.

sam: From a correctness POV, endpoint-level p95 should be computed from the full request stream (weighted by route count). If we show per-variant percentiles, we should either compute them from the same full stream or explicitly label them as sampled approximations.

aria: Another corner case: when rollout weights are tiny (0.5% -> fallback), that small percentage can dominate tail if it's slower, and endpoint p99 will jump. If the variant pane is sampled and misses those rare slow requests, you'll never see the cause.

mike: Could we surface "route-weighted sample counts" in the UI? A tiny badge: "route weight 0.5% (est. 80 reqs/min)" so users can immediately see if a route could affect the tail.

jen: Implementation note: computing accurate per-variant percentiles on-demand will cost, but we already have an on-demand heavy query system for postmortems. Reuse that with a 1-click "Compute accurate percentiles" button.

aria: UX copy suggestion: "Endpoint percentiles reflect the full rollup stream (route-weighted). Variant cards show a fast sampled view — click \"Accurate\" to recompute from full data."

sam: For telemetry API, we should add an explicit param: `weight_mode=rollup|sampled|uniform`. Default `rollup` for endpoint queries, default `sampled` for variant cards. That makes intent explicit in calls.

mike: Example call we can document: 
```
GET /telemetry/query?metric=latency_ms&group_by=variant&percentiles=95&start=...&end=...&weight_mode=rollup
```

dashbot: [deploy-bot] Note: console-rollout-ux branch deployed to staging at 1768889005.

aria: Thanks @dashbot. I'll prototype a tiny badge + tooltip in staging and wire the accurate query button to the heavy query path.

jen: I'll write the console-ux ticket and link telemetry API changes: CONSOLE-4321. Assign to @mike for front-end and @sam for telemetry API.

sam: I'll follow up with PR for `weight_mode` param and tweak sampling docs.

mike: I'll prototype the badge, tooltip, and a modal that shows the estimated route-weighted impact.

aria: Great. Action items summarized: 1) add sampled badge + tooltip (FE) 2) add "Compute accurate percentiles" button wired to heavy query (FE + API) 3) add `weight_mode` param to telemetry API + docs (API) 4) expose route weight estimates beside variant cards (FE + infra).

aria: Thanks all :thumbsup:

sam: 👍

jen: filing: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CONSOLE-4321 (description: disparity between endpoint rollup percentiles and sampled variant panes; propose badge + accurate query + weight_mode API)

aria: I'll monitor staging after the deploy and report back if the spike reproducible.

mike: ping me if you need a quick UX mock for the badge.
